entertainment.name_base: Jiushiye Matcha Specialty Shop (Wangfu Zhonghuan East Tower)
entertainment.name_local: 九十叶·抹茶专门店(王府中环东座店)
entertainment.location_base: B1F, Unit 101F, East Tower, Wangfu Zhonghuan, 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号王府中环东座B1层101F
entertainment.type_local: 抹茶专门店 / 抹茶下午茶
entertainment.note_base: PRIMARY OPTION. Dedicated Japanese-style matcha specialty shop inside Wangfu Zhonghuan; known for matcha lattes, matcha dessert sets, and seasonal matcha specials — perfect mid-shopping matcha break.
entertainment.note_local: 首选。王府中环内日式抹茶专门店，主打抹茶拿铁、抹茶甜品套餐及季节限定抹茶特饮，购物途中抹茶下午茶的绝佳之选。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~40-60 CNY per person. Located in B1F of Wangfu Zhonghuan East Tower — same mall as théATRE Tea on L4. Open 10:00-22:00 daily. Rating 4.5. Great for a relaxing sit-down matcha experience between shopping rounds.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均40-60元，位于王府中环东座B1层，与茶聚场théATRE同楼。每日10:00-22:00营业，评分4.5分。购物间隙坐下来慢慢享受一杯抹茶，氛围感满分。

entertainment.location_base: L1, Beijing APM Mall, 138 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街138号北京apm商场L1层
entertainment.note_base: ALTERNATIVE OPTION (matcha/tea style). HEYTEA is China's leading premium fresh-brewed tea brand, famous for cheese tea, grape jasmine tea, and seasonal fruit teas. The Wangfujing APM location is one of the most accessible on the street.
entertainment.note_local: 备选（茶饮风格）。喜茶是国内顶级新茶饮品牌，主打芝士茶、葡萄茉莉及季节限定水果茶，王府井apm店位置极为便捷。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~25-45 CNY per drink. No seating reservation needed — takeaway or limited in-store seating. Located in Beijing APM mall, ~5 min walk from Wangfu Zhonghuan. Open daily 10:00-22:00. Good pick if Jiushiye Matcha is full or you prefer lighter fresh-brewed tea over matcha desserts.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均25-45元/杯，无需预约，可外带或少量堂食。位于北京apm商场，距王府中环步行约5分钟。每日10:00-22:00营业。若九十叶抹茶满座，或更倾向清爽果茶而非抹茶甜品，可选此处。

entertainment.name_local: 芒果芒果甜品(王府井店)
entertainment.location_base: Wangfujing Pedestrian Street area, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街步行街区域
entertainment.note_base: ALTERNATIVE OPTION (different style — dessert). A popular mango dessert shop in the Wangfujing pedestrian area offering mango sago, mango smoothie bowls, and fresh fruit dessert cups — a refreshing break option if you prefer cold desserts over hot tea.
entertainment.note_local: 备选（不同风格——甜品）。王府井步行街区的热门芒果甜品店，主打芒果西米露、芒果冰沙碗和鲜果甜品杯，喜欢冷甜品胜过热茶的不二之选。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~30-50 CNY per person. Located along Wangfujing pedestrian street or nearby side alleys — easy to find while walking the strip. Ideal if the weather is warm (early April in Beijing can be mild). No reservation needed, quick takeaway or sit-in.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均30-50元，位于王府井步行街或附近小巷，逛街途中随走随进。四月初北京天气渐暖时尤为适合。无需预约，可外带或堂食。

entertainment.location_base: L4, Unit 414, East Tower, Wangfu Zhonghuan, 269 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号王府中环东座L4层414
entertainment.note_base: Theatrical concept tea-house brand with dramatic interior design; one of Beijing's most photogenic afternoon tea spots.
entertainment.note_local: 具有戏剧感的网红茶饮空间，室内设计极具视觉冲击力，出片率极高。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~60-90 CNY per person for drinks and light snacks. Located in Wangfu Zhonghuan on upper floors. Recommended alternative to Jiushiye Matcha in the same mall.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均60-90元含轻食，位于王府中环上层，与九十叶抹茶同楼，可择一打卡。

entertainment.location_base: L4, Unit 430, Beijing APM Mall, 138 Wangfujing Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街138号北京apmL4层430
entertainment.type_local: 书店 / 生活方式逛店
entertainment.note_base: Premium lifestyle bookstore known for curated art, design, and travel books alongside stylish stationery. The Beijing APM flagship is among the city's most photogenic bookstores.
entertainment.note_local: 高端生活方式书店，精选艺术/设计/旅行类书籍，环境优美，是北京最上镜的书店之一。
entertainment.notes_base: Free entry; budget 50-200 CNY if purchasing books or stationery gifts. Located in Beijing APM mall on Wangfujing Street — easy to slot in between shopping stops.
entertainment.notes_local: 免费入场；购书或文创周边预算50-200元。位于北京apm商场，购物途中顺路可逛。

entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街256号
entertainment.note_base: Wangfujing Pedestrian Street is beautifully illuminated in the evening and perfect for a relaxing post-dinner stroll and couple photos. In early April the area is lively with spring shoppers.
entertainment.note_local: 王府井步行街夜晚灯光璀璨，饭后漫步氛围极佳，适合拍情侣照。四月初春，人气旺盛。
entertainment.notes_base: Free. Best enjoyed after dinner ~19:30-21:00 when neon lights and store displays are at their brightest. Easy walk between mall exits.
entertainment.notes_local: 免费。晚饭后19:30-21:00最佳，霓虹灯与橱窗灯光最绚丽，各商场出口间步行可达。

entertainment.location_base: Unit 104, 1F, 157 Dongsi South Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
entertainment.location_local: 北京市东城区东四南大街157号1层104号
entertainment.note_base: One of Beijing's most celebrated craft beer bars, a short walk from Dongdan/Wangfujing. Excellent selection of house-brewed ales, IPAs, and seasonal taps in a relaxed atmosphere.
entertainment.note_local: 北京最知名的精酿啤酒吧之一，距东单/王府井步行可达，自酿麦酒、IPA及季节限定款丰富，氛围轻松惬意。
entertainment.notes_base: Budget ~80-150 CNY per person for 2-3 pints. Open until midnight. No reservation needed on weeknights. Located near Dengshikou Metro Station Exit A.
entertainment.notes_local: 人均80-150元可喝2-3杯，营业至午夜，工作日无需预订。灯市口地铁站A出口旁。
